\boxed{
\begin{aligned}
Q_{\pi}(s_t,a_t)
&=
\mathbb{E}_{s_{t+1},a_{t+1},\ldots}
\left[
\sum_{l=0}^{\infty}
\gamma^l c(s_{t+l})
\right],
\\[6pt]
V_{\pi}(s_t)
&=
\mathbb{E}_{a_t,s_{t+1},\ldots}
\left[
\sum_{l=0}^{\infty}
\gamma^l c(s_{t+l})
\right],
\\[6pt]
A_{\pi}(s,a)
&=
Q_{\pi}(s,a)-V_{\pi}(s),
\quad \text{where}
\\[4pt]
a_t
&\sim
\pi(a_t \mid s_t),
\quad
s_{t+1}
\sim
P(s_{t+1}\mid s_t,a_t),
\quad
\text{for } t \geq 0.
\end{aligned}
}

\begin{aligned}
\hat{A}_t^{(1)} &:= \delta_t^V &&= -V(s_t) + r_t + \gamma V(s_{t+1}) \\
\hat{A}_t^{(2)} &:= \delta_t^V + \gamma \delta_{t+1}^V &&= -V(s_t) + r_t + \gamma r_{t+1} + \gamma^2 V(s_{t+2}) \\
\hat{A}_t^{(3)} &:= \delta_t^V + \gamma \delta_{t+1}^V + \gamma^2 \delta_{t+2}^V &&= -V(s_t) + r_t + \gamma r_{t+1} + \gamma^2 r_{t+2} + \gamma^3 V(s_{t+3}) \\
& \\
\hat{A}_t^{(k)} &:= \sum_{l=0}^{k-1} \gamma^l \delta_{t+l}^V &&= -V(s_t) + r_t + \gamma r_{t+1} + \cdots + \gamma^{k-1} r_{t+k-1} + \gamma^k V(s_{t+k})
\end{aligned}
\nabla_\theta \log \pi_\theta(a_t \mid s_t) A^{\pi, \gamma}(s_t, a_t) = \nabla_\theta \log \pi_\theta(a_t \mid s_t) \sum_{l=0}^{\infty} \gamma^l \chi(l; s_t, a_t).
L^{CLIP+VF+S}_{t}(\theta) = \hat{\mathbb{E}}_{t} \left[ L^{CLIP}_{t}(\theta) - c_1 L^{VF}_{t}(\theta) + c_2 S[\pi_{\theta}](s_t) \right]
